title: AtomicRL: Atomic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30097v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic manipulation, but imitation learning (IL) alone often struggles to master complex long-horizon skills. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers an effective avenue for further improving VLA policies. However, existing VLA-RL methods typically suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to trajectory-level sparse rewards, while imbalanced subtask mastery creates bottlenecks that limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration. AtomicRL introduces Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses semantic-aware gating to constrain TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks from propagating across task boundaries, mitigating credit contamination while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and value bootstrapping.

translated_title: AtomicRL：面向长时程机器人操作的原子强化学习
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作领域已展现出巨大潜力，但仅依靠模仿学习（IL）往往难以掌握复杂的长时程技能。强化学习（RL）为进一步提升VLA策略提供了有效途径。然而，现有的VLA-RL方法通常由于轨迹级稀疏奖励而面临延迟且有偏的信用分配问题，同时子任务掌握程度不均衡会形成限制整体性能的瓶颈。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了AtomicRL，这是一个利用原子任务结构实现可靠信用分配和自适应探索的强化学习后训练框架。AtomicRL引入了语义感知策略优化，其使用语义感知门控机制来阻止失败原子子任务产生的TD残差跨任务边界传播，在缓解信用污染的同时保留了子任务内部的信用分配与价值自举。
tldr: AtomicRL提出了一个利用原子任务结构的强化学习后训练框架，通过语义感知策略优化（SAPO）阻止失败子任务的TD残差跨任务边界传播，解决了VLA-RL中信用分配延迟且有偏以及子任务掌握不均衡的问题。
en_tdlr: AtomicRL is an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures, introducing Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO) to gate TD residuals from failed subtasks within task boundaries, addressing delayed and biased credit assignment and imbalanced subtask mastery in VLA-RL.
